How to Find ESRIG
People of ESRIG
Based on the vision that abundant and cheap supply of energy is one of the most positive things that ever happened to humanity, and that the continuation and extension of this supply is crucial and at the same time threatened, ESRIG has formulated its mission
to contribute to sustainable energy utilization and resource exploitation in the coming century for more people.
